name: Disney Frozen - Olaf's Quest
description:
This is a side-scrolling action game featuring the always cheerful and mischievous Olaf from the Disney movie ``Frozen.''
Olaf goes on an adventure to collect as many beautiful flowers as he can to give a bouquet to his beloved Anna.
If you find a lot of flowers and items on the stage, you will be able to enjoy Olaf's fashion.
Characters from the movie such as Sven and Marshmallow also appear!
Help Olaf fly, roll, and do his best.
